title: Operate a Tipper Station Using the Self-Contained HMI: Clamp tote, dump to chute, and return tote to AGV
summary: At an OptiSweep tipper station, each operator station uses two tippers. The tipper clamps the tote arriving from the AGV, actuates the tipping arm to dump contents onto the chute, and then places the tote back onto the AGV. Operation is performed using the tipper station’s self-contained HMI and the operator “ready to tip” button/control; use the operator E-stop only for safety.
when_to_use: Use this procedure when you are at a tipper station operator position and need to tip a clamped tote so its contents dump onto the chute, then return the tote to the AGV using the station’s self-contained HMI and the “ready to tip” control.
roles_and_responsibilities: Operator: Perform the tip cycle at the self-contained tipper station HMI using the “ready to tip” control, and use the operator E-stop only as required for safety.
safety_notes: Use the operator E-stop only as the safety control described for the operator station.
access_or_tools_needed: Operator access to the tipper station
Self-contained HMI for operation and fault recovery
“Ready to tip” button/control on the tipper station HMI

access_required: Operator access to the tipper station
system_preconditions: A tote is staged/arriving at the tipper station from the AGV so the tipper can clamp it.

visual_references.description: Tipper station operator station slide showing: each station has two tippers; tipper clamps tote from AGV; actuates tipping arm to dump contents onto chute; places tote back onto AGV; self-contained HMI for operation and fault recovery; operators equipped with Estop and a button that says “I’m ready to tip.”

steps.title: Identify the correct operator station tipper (each operator station has two tippers)
steps.purpose: Ensure you are operating the correct tipper at the correct operator station for the tote that is arriving from the AGV.
steps.instruction: At the tipper station, identify the operator station position and the tipper(s) available there (each operator station has two tippers).
steps.expected_result: You have identified the correct operator station tipper to use for the incoming tote from the AGV.
steps.healthy_condition: The tipper you select is the one associated with the operator station where the tote is arriving to be clamped.
steps.failure_condition: You select the wrong operator station tipper (the tote you intend to tip is not the one being clamped by the selected tipper).

actions.label: Confirm station has two tippers
actions.exact_action: Identify the correct operator station tipper (each operator station has two tippers).

stop_or_escalate_if: If you cannot confidently identify the correct operator station tipper for the incoming tote, stop and request assistance before pressing “ready to tip.”

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Each of the operator stations have two tippers.

steps.title: Confirm the tipper clamps the tote coming in from the AGV
steps.purpose: Clamping is required before the tipping arm can dump contents onto the chute.
steps.instruction: Observe the tipper operation at the self-contained HMI/at the station to confirm the tipper clamps the tote coming in from the AGV.
steps.expected_result: The tipper clamps the tote from the AGV.
steps.healthy_condition: The tote is held/clamped by the tipper (i.e., the clamp action occurs for the incoming tote).
steps.failure_condition: The tipper does not clamp the tote from the AGV.

actions.label: Verify clamp action
actions.exact_action: Confirm the tipper clamps the tote coming in from the AGV.

stop_or_escalate_if: If the tipper does not clamp the tote, stop the operation and escalate for fault recovery using the self-contained HMI fault recovery capability mentioned by the source.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Tipper will clamp tote from AGV.

steps.title: On the self-contained HMI at the tipper station, use the control/button that indicates you are “ready to tip”
steps.purpose: Trigger the tip cycle from the operator station using the station’s self-contained HMI control.
steps.instruction: On the tipper station’s self-contained HMI, use the operator control/button labeled “I’m ready to tip” / “ready to tip” to start the tip cycle.
steps.expected_result: The tip cycle is initiated from the self-contained HMI using the “ready to tip” control.
steps.healthy_condition: After pressing “ready to tip,” the station proceeds to the tipping action (tipping arm actuation) for the clamped tote.
steps.failure_condition: After pressing “ready to tip,” the tipping arm does not actuate (or the cycle does not proceed).

actions.label: Press ready-to-tip
actions.exact_action: Use the control/button that indicates you are “ready to tip.”

stop_or_escalate_if: If the tipper does not clamp, does not dump to the chute, or does not return the tote to the AGV, stop the operation and escalate for fault recovery using the self-contained HMI fault recovery capability mentioned by the source.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: HMI ... and then like a button that says I'm ready to tip.

steps.title: Verify the tipper actuates the tipping arm to dump contents onto the chute
steps.purpose: Confirm the discharge phase occurs so contents dump onto the chute.
steps.instruction: Watch/verify that the tipper actuates the tipping arm and dumps the contents onto the chute during the tip cycle.
steps.expected_result: The tipping arm actuates and dumps contents onto the chute.
steps.healthy_condition: Contents are discharged onto the chute as the tipping arm actuates.
steps.failure_condition: The tipper does not dump contents onto the chute.

actions.label: Verify dump to chute
actions.exact_action: Verify the tipper actuates the tipping arm to dump contents onto the chute.

stop_or_escalate_if: If the tipper does not dump to the chute, stop the operation and escalate for fault recovery using the self-contained HMI fault recovery capability mentioned by the source.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Actuators tip the arm to dump contents onto the chute.

steps.title: Verify the tote is placed back onto the AGV after dumping
steps.purpose: Complete the cycle by returning the tote to the AGV after discharge.
steps.instruction: After the dump completes, verify that the tipper places the tote back onto the AGV.
steps.expected_result: The tote is returned/placed back onto the AGV after dumping.
steps.healthy_condition: The tote is no longer held by the tipper and is placed back onto the AGV.
steps.failure_condition: The tote is not returned to the AGV after dumping.

actions.label: Verify tote return
actions.exact_action: Verify the tote is placed back onto the AGV after dumping.

stop_or_escalate_if: If the tipper does not return the tote to the AGV, stop the operation and escalate for fault recovery using the self-contained HMI fault recovery capability mentioned by the source.

steps.title: Use the operator E-stop only as the safety control described for the operator station
steps.purpose: Ensure safety controls are used correctly during abnormal or unsafe conditions.
steps.instruction: If safety requires stopping, use the operator E-stop at the operator station. Do not use it as a routine control for normal tip cycles.
steps.expected_result: E-stop is used only when required for safety; normal operation proceeds without unnecessary E-stop activation.
steps.healthy_condition: No unsafe condition exists; the tip cycle completes without needing E-stop.
steps.failure_condition: E-stop is used unnecessarily or when safety is not required, or safety is ignored during an unsafe condition.

actions.label: Use operator E-stop for safety
actions.exact_action: Use the operator E-stop only as the safety control described for the operator station.

stop_or_escalate_if: Stop and use the operator E-stop if required for safety.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Operators equipped with Estop and ready to tip buttons.

success_criteria: Tote is clamped from the AGV by the selected tipper.
Tipping arm actuates and dumps contents onto the chute.
Tote is placed back onto the AGV after dumping.
Operation is performed via the self-contained HMI using the “ready to tip” control.
healthy_conditions: Tipper clamps the incoming tote from the AGV.
After pressing “ready to tip,” the tipping arm actuates to dump contents onto the chute.
After dumping, the tote is returned/placed back onto the AGV.
Operator E-stop is not used unless required for safety.
failure_conditions: Tipper does not clamp the tote from the AGV.
Tipper does not dump contents onto the chute.
Tipper does not return the tote to the AGV.
escalation_guidance: If the tipper does not clamp, does not dump to the chute, or does not return the tote to the AGV, stop the operation and escalate for fault recovery using the self-contained HMI fault recovery capability mentioned by the source.
